body:
## What it does

It sits across your applicant tracking system, LinkedIn and your inbox, gathering what has already been said about a candidate in scattered conversations. From that context it will put together a first draft of a contractor agreement or a formal offer, leaving every hiring decision itself to you.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @xsubwayratx shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
